segments.a: Every winter, Calgary's icy sidewalks wait five to eleven days for help. This is the real storm week of November 2025.
segments.b: Same crews. Same tickets. Oldest-first reaches just thirteen percent of high-risk sidewalks in two days. SnowTech? Forty-three percent. And driving drops from 8,652 kilometres to just 2,848.
segments.c: This is the live plan, on Calgary's real roads. A resident calls our voice agent about snowpack at the University of Calgary bus loop. Two seconds later, it's in a crew's route, ranked number one, because a wheelchair user is stuck.
segments.d: Three officers call in sick? SnowTech re-plans every route in four seconds flat.
segments.e: A language model listens. A solver decides. Every decision, explained. This is SnowTech.
